setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (4, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['title'] = [f'item_{i:04d}' for i in range(n)]

steps.name: run html export with tooltip columns
steps.eval: const titleCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'title'); const clusterCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'cluster'); a.exportHtml({ tooltipColumns: [titleCol.index, clusterCol.index], linkColumn: -1, maxChars: 200, embedImages: false, samplePct: 100 })
